title: Processional
program_note:
Processional was written for Anne P. Kaplan and Elon Spar, to be played as part of their wedding ceremony on March 5, 1994.  I have known Annie virtually my entire life—we have grown up together and shared many many special experiences.  This quintet is a small token of my love for her—and for her new husband—and features the French Horn, Annie’s favorite instrument.

I hope that my composition has added to the joy of this happy occasion.

David S. Lefkowitz

2 March 1994

Rochester, NY
